title: The Sapote-Mamey Diner Menu
purpose: A claim-safe registry of user-facing outcomes, their real producing commands, required evidence, gates, and authority ceilings.
identity_contract: strain / full node-or-contig / region / BGC alias
global_claim_ceiling: Similarity is not identity; capacity is not production; missing or unbound evidence is not biological absence. Gate success verifies encoded checks, not biological identity, activity, novelty, acceptance, or publication readiness.

delivery_classes.DETERMINISTIC_BUILT_IN: Produced by bundled deterministic code from admitted inputs.
delivery_classes.OPTIONAL_LOCAL_ADAPTER: Available only when the named local tool, database, or result is present and admitted.
delivery_classes.POST_SEAL_JUDGMENT: A Sapote judgment deliverable built after MAMEY_COMPLETE; it is not deterministic Mamey extraction.
delivery_classes.OPTIONAL_EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW: May require separately authorized external contact; staging alone does not authorize contact.
delivery_classes.GOVERNANCE_AND_QA: A validation, provenance, privacy, handoff, or release-control outcome.
delivery_classes.HUMAN_REVIEW_PROTOCOL: A structured human/LLM review protocol rather than an engine-generated scientific result.

groups.title: The Evidence Bar - bind before interpreting
The Check - provenance, QA, and handoff

deliverables.name: Triage Board
deliverables.question: What biosynthetic capacity is in this strain?
deliverables.summary: Ranked, source-derived BGC inventory with class calls, routing priors, evidence states, and complete physical locators.
triggers: Give me the triage board
What BGCs are in this strain?
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Routing priority and biosynthetic-capacity hypothesis only.

deliverables.name: Lead Sheet
deliverables.question: Which loci deserve attention first?
deliverables.summary: A short, evidence-weighted lead board that names why each exact locus was prioritized and what remains unresolved.
triggers: Give me the lead sheet
What are the top leads?
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Prioritization, not product identity, production, or activity.

deliverables.name: Layered BGC Guide
deliverables.question: Explain a locus to both non-specialists and specialists.
deliverables.summary: A layered lay-to-technical per-gene guide with structure, function, evidence-channel separation, and explicit holds.
triggers: Write a layered guide for this exact locus
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Gene-role interpretation remains evidence-weighted and conditional.

deliverables.name: Locus Map and Atlas
deliverables.question: Show the physical gene neighborhood.
deliverables.summary: Gene-arrow or contig-level views with complete locus identity, visible label-denominator disclosure, and source-data sidecars.
triggers: Make a locus map for STRAIN-001 / NODE_12_length_48000_cov_30.1 / region001 / BGC007
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Physical organization and annotation display; not proof of pathway operation.

deliverables.label: E1
deliverables.name: Mode B Evidence Availability
deliverables.question: Which evidence is physically present and exactly bound before prose?
deliverables.summary: A pre-authoring manifest that separates available, admitted, unbound, absent-in-scope, and superseded evidence streams.
triggers: Audit Mode B evidence availability before authoring
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Availability and binding state only; missing evidence is not a biological negative.

deliverables.label: E2
deliverables.name: Targeted Protein Evidence
deliverables.question: What do the most informative proteins resemble?
deliverables.summary: Target selection, FASTA staging, result import, and channel-separated availability for full nr, ClusteredNR, and pinned local Swiss-Prot.
triggers: Build the targeted protein evidence panel
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Named sequence similarity with explicit denominators; never identity or function by resemblance alone.

deliverables.label: E3
deliverables.name: Optional External BLASTP Workflow
deliverables.question: Prepare or run an explicitly authorized remote protein search.
deliverables.summary: A separately governed remote-search workflow. FASTA preparation does not itself authorize submission, polling, or URL access.
triggers: Run the authorized external BLASTP workflow
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Remote similarity evidence only; authorization is per transaction.

deliverables.label: E4
deliverables.name: MIBiG, ClusterBlast, and BiG-SCAPE Context
deliverables.question: How does this exact locus compare with reference clusters and the cohort?
deliverables.summary: Keeps source-local ClusterBlast, gene-level MIBiG anchors, whole-locus majority reads, and cutoff-specific BiG-SCAPE families distinct.
triggers: Reconcile MIBiG, ClusterBlast, and BiG-SCAPE evidence
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Comparator navigation and family context; class discordance cannot support product identity or novelty.

deliverables.label: E5
deliverables.name: Phylogenomics Context
deliverables.question: What is the approved genome-scale comparator context?
deliverables.summary: Approval-gated GToTree/IQ-TREE/ANI context with explicit outgroups, tip cleaning, and source receipts.
triggers: Build the approved phylogenomics context
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Comparator placement and nucleotide/protein similarity; taxonomy and novelty require their own admitted evidence.

deliverables.name: Mode B 48-Section Deep Dive
deliverables.question: What does all admitted evidence support for one exact locus?
deliverables.summary: A complete 48-section, gene-oriented evidence reconciliation with alternatives, discriminating tests, typed holds, and loss audit.
triggers: Write full Mode B for STRAIN-001 / NODE_12_length_48000_cov_30.1 / region001 / BGC007
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Candidate interpretation only unless separately accepted; capacity is not production.

deliverables.name: Full Strain Analysis
deliverables.question: Integrate extraction, lead interpretation, figures, and next actions for one strain.
deliverables.summary: A governed compilation of the sealed package and independently gated post-seal deliverables; unavailable components remain typed rather than silently omitted.
triggers: Build the full strain analysis
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Compilation does not raise the authority of its component evidence.

deliverables.name: Split-Pathway and Assembly-Line Reconstruction
deliverables.question: Could measured biosynthetic capacity span boundaries or multiple regions?
deliverables.summary: RG-GMCI, protocluster, over-merge, and domain-architecture views with explicit physical-linkage limits and alternative assignments.
triggers: Reconstruct the measured split pathway
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Co-occurrence or linkage score is not proof of one biosynthetic product.

deliverables.name: Cohort and GCF Atlas
deliverables.question: What biosynthetic capacity is shared or strain-private across a governed cohort?
deliverables.summary: Cross-strain synthesis, source-derived cohort tables, and cutoff-specific GCF context with denominator and comparator-composition limits.
triggers: Build the cohort comparison
Build the cross-strain GCF atlas
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Measured cohort prevalence and clustering only; sampling and cutoff choices bound interpretation.

deliverables.label: S1
deliverables.name: Domain and Tailoring Review
deliverables.question: Which measured domains and tailoring families change the pathway alternatives?
deliverables.summary: Post-seal domain grammar, P450 context, and assembly-line enrichment kept separate from inferred reaction assignment.
triggers: Add the domain and tailoring review
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Domain capacity and architecture; reaction assignment remains conditional.

deliverables.label: S2
deliverables.name: Reference-Dark and Novelty Shortlist
deliverables.question: Which genes or loci remain poorly anchored to admitted references?
deliverables.summary: Reference-dark and novelty-routing views that preserve missing-channel and comparator-coverage limitations.
triggers: Show the reference-dark genes and novelty shortlist
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Reference darkness is not novelty; missing evidence is not biological absence.

deliverables.label: S3
deliverables.name: Figure Set and Comparative Clinker
deliverables.question: Create source-backed visuals without changing the scientific verdict.
deliverables.summary: Data-sidecar-backed figures, BGC diagrams, GCF networks, and comparative Clinker views generated after the package seal.
triggers: Build the source-backed figure set
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Visualization of admitted measurements; figures do not upgrade inference.

deliverables.label: S4
deliverables.name: Local Literature Context
deliverables.question: What does the pinned local literature corpus say about the named families?
deliverables.summary: Offline lookup and search over the bundled corpus, followed by claim-level citation adjudication in Sapote judgment.
triggers: Search the local literature corpus for this enzyme family
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Literature supplies family or comparator context unless exact experimental identity is independently established.

deliverables.label: S5
deliverables.name: Bench Planning Matrix
deliverables.question: What experiments would discriminate the leading pathway alternatives?
deliverables.summary: A judgment-layer fermentation, detection, metabolomics, and wet-lab decision matrix tied to explicit hypotheses and uncertainties.
triggers: Build a hypothesis-linked bench planning matrix
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Experimental planning, not evidence that a compound is produced or active.

deliverables.label: G1
deliverables.name: Workflow and Evidence Receipt
deliverables.question: Which required stages passed, remain pending, or are blocked?
deliverables.summary: A machine-readable Sapote workflow ledger and additive evidence-receipt ingestion without mutating the sealed extraction package.
triggers: Show the workflow and evidence receipt status
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Process state and provenance only.

deliverables.label: G2
deliverables.name: Claim and Citation Audit
deliverables.question: Does the authored interpretation stay within its evidence and identity contract?
deliverables.summary: Post-hoc claim-safety, complete-locus citation, and authored-content gates over finished files.
triggers: Audit the claims and exact-locus citations
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Mechanical and encoded semantic checks; not scientific acceptance.

deliverables.label: G3
deliverables.name: Reproducible Handoff
deliverables.question: Can another operator identify the exact inputs, outputs, and resume point?
deliverables.summary: Fingerprints, manifests, durable state, and a portable handoff that preserves source identity and unresolved holds.
triggers: Build the reproducible handoff
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Reproducibility and custody only; no acceptance or release implication.

deliverables.label: G4
deliverables.name: Release QA and Privacy Review
deliverables.question: Is a candidate mechanically ready for an authorized release decision?
deliverables.summary: Release checks, privacy-tier controls, and sign-off receipts. Passing does not grant release authority.
triggers: Run candidate release QA
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Mechanical candidate readiness only; owner approval remains separate.

deliverables.label: G5
deliverables.name: Adversarial Patch Review
deliverables.question: What breaks, conflicts, or remains unproven in a proposed change?
deliverables.summary: A bounded source-first review protocol for patch applicability, conflicts, tests, provenance, and claim ceilings.
triggers: Run an adversarial patch review
Can we Bunny Hop?
deliverables.claim_ceiling: Review recommendation only; no integration, acceptance, or release authority.
